answer.rationale: memory_c2 supports that the low-cost vendor can be onboarded quickly with accurate invoicing and sharp unit-cost reduction; memory_c6 shows multi-year commitments unlock volume pricing, so I would seek a multi-year commitment with the low-cost vendor to lock the 18% savings. I am not pulling memory_c1 because renewing the incumbent does not meet the finance mandate alone, and I am not pulling memory_c3 because adding a second source does not by itself cut spend 18%. The main risk is delivery continuity with the assembly line at 94% and no buffer, so I would structure the switch with a short overlap or confirm the low-cost vendor can meet committed volume before full cutover.
